description: A maximality rejection reports the first terminator that maximality forbids in the first reading of the ranking with both forms off. T is not maximal, so its omission after b → X counts, although b → X C is longer. U is maximal, and c → X B is longer than c → X, so the report names U at 4, not T at 2 (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable T
%elidable maximal U
%rule text A b [T] C c [U] B
%rule b X | X C
%rule c X | X B
